create_fasta_batched_dataset: create a FastaBatchedDataset from a FASTA file using the from_file class method
get_batch_indices: get batch indices for sequences in a FastaBatchedDataset based on tokens per batch size
create_alphabet_from_architecture: create an ESM Alphabet object from a named architecture like ESM-1 or ESM-1b
convert_batch_with_batchconverter: convert a raw batch of protein sequence labels and strings into tokenized tensors using BatchConverter
read_fasta_sequences: read and parse protein sequences from a FASTA file with optional gap and insertion filtering
